senses.gloss: f. (θηριακή, theriaca) theriak, a certain compound believed to be an antidote against poisonous bites; in general a remedy, medicine.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 109b">Sabb. 109ᵇ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1), v. <cite ref="K00831"><he>כַּנְגַּד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 41b:1">Ned. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>כי תירייקי לגופא</he> (Ar. <he>קא …</he>) as wholesome as theriac for the body.
<cite ref="Nedarim 41b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לא היא ולא תִירְיָיקָהּ</he> I want neither it (the fever) nor its alleged good effect.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:5">Cant. R. to IV, 5</cite> [read:] <he>שלחו הרופאים והביאו מדמיהן ועשו אותן תִּרְיָאקָה ובה וכ׳</he> the physicians sent (to Alexandria) and got some of their blood (of menstruation) and made a theriak of it, and with it they healed &c.—[<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:4">Ab. Zar. II, 4</cite> <he>ותירייקי</he> Y. ed., v. <cite ref="F00107"><he>וְתִינְיָיקִי</he></cite>.]
